description: This file defines the AppCommandProvider class, a React component that provides command suggestions and handles app command interactions within the Mattermost web application. It manages parsing user input, generating suggestions, and opening app modals based on commands.

classes.name: AppCommandProvider
classes.description: A React component class that provides command suggestions and handles app command interactions within the Mattermost web app.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the AppCommandProvider with props, setting up the store, parser, and trigger character.

methods.name: setProps
methods.description: Updates the parser's channel context based on new props.

methods.name: handlePretextChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in user input pretext, providing command suggestions if applicable.

methods.name: openAppsModalFromCommand
methods.description: Parses a command from pretext and opens the corresponding app modal if valid.
